However, during this process, the number of current carrying particles per <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi></mrow></msup></math>decreases, hence specific conductivity <math> <mrow>  <mfenced>   <mrow>    <msub>     <mtext>K</mtext>     <mtext>c</mtext>    </msub>    </mrow>  </mfenced></mrow></math> decreases.
